source.text: ק֥וּמִי א֖וֹרִי כִּ֣י בָ֣א אוֹרֵ֑ךְ וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עָלַ֥יִךְ זָרָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, shine, for has come your light, and [the] glory of Yahweh on you has dawned.

en.L: Arise, shine, for your light has come, \q and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} upon you has dawned.
en.B: Rise up and shine, for your light has come; \q the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has dawned over you.
en.R: Get up, Jerusalem, and shine! Your light has come. \q The glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is shining on you like the sunrise.

es.L: Levántate, resplandece, porque ha llegado tu luz, \q y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha amanecido sobre ti.
es.B: Levántate y brilla, porque tu luz ha llegado; \q la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha amanecido sobre ti.
es.R: ¡Levántate, Jerusalén, y brilla! Tu luz ha llegado. \q La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} brilla sobre ti como la salida del sol.

fr.L: Lève-toi, brille, car ta lumière est venue, \q et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est levée sur toi.
fr.B: Lève-toi et resplendis, car ta lumière est venue ; \q la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’est levée sur toi.
fr.R: Lève-toi, Jérusalem, et brille ! Ta lumière est arrivée. \q La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} brille sur toi comme le soleil qui se lève.

sw.L: Inuka, angaza, kwa maana nuru yako imekuja, \q na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umekuzukia.
sw.B: Simama uangaze, kwa maana nuru yako imefika; \q utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} umekuchomozea.
sw.R: Inuka, Yerusalemu, uangaze! Nuru yako imekuja. \q Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unakuangazia kama jua linalochomoza.

decisions.choice: the one addressed is Zion, the city of Jerusalem, pictured as a woman
decisions.reason: The commands and every "you" and "your" in the chapter are feminine singular, and verse 14 names her: "the City of the LORD, Zion". The city stands for its people, as in 49:14-21; 51:17; 52:1-2, where Zion is also told to rise.

decisions.choice: your light has come, the glory of the LORD has dawned: God's own presence rising over the city like the sun
decisions.reason: The verb for "dawned" is used of the sun rising (Genesis 32:32; Malachi 3:20). Light for a people in darkness was promised in 9:1 and 58:8, 10, and the glory of the LORD was to be revealed in 40:5. Revelation 21:23-26 takes up this chapter in its picture of the new Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Get up, Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable names the city that is addressed, since the Hebrew shows it only by feminine forms (see m1).

source.text: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה הַחֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ יְכַסֶּה־אֶ֔רֶץ וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֑ים וְעָלַ֨יִךְ֙ יִזְרַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וּכְבוֹד֖וֹ עָלַ֥יִךְ יֵרָאֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, the darkness will cover [the] earth, and thick darkness [the] peoples; and on you will dawn Yahweh, and his glory over you will appear.

en.L: For look, darkness will cover the earth, \q and deep darkness the peoples; \q but over you {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will dawn, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory over you will be seen.
en.B: Look: darkness will cover the earth \q and a heavy gloom will lie on the peoples, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will rise like the dawn over you, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory will be seen above you.
en.R: Look! Darkness will cover the earth. \q Deep darkness will cover its peoples. \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will shine on you like the rising sun. \q People will see {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory over you.

es.L: Porque, mira, las tinieblas cubrirán la tierra, \q y densa oscuridad los pueblos; \q pero sobre ti amanecerá {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria se verá sobre ti.
es.B: Mira: la oscuridad cubrirá la tierra \q y una pesada penumbra caerá sobre los pueblos, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se levantará como el alba sobre ti, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria se verá encima de ti.
es.R: ¡Mira! La oscuridad cubrirá la tierra. \q Una oscuridad profunda cubrirá a sus pueblos. \q Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} brillará sobre ti como el sol que sale. \q La gente verá {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria sobre ti.

fr.L: Car voici, les ténèbres couvriront la terre, \q et l’obscurité profonde les peuples ; \q mais sur toi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se lèvera, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire sur toi sera vue.
fr.B: Voici : les ténèbres couvriront la terre \q et une épaisse obscurité pèsera sur les peuples, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se lèvera sur toi comme l’aurore, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire se verra au-dessus de toi.
fr.R: Regarde ! L’obscurité couvrira la terre. \q Une obscurité profonde couvrira ses peuples. \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} brillera sur toi comme le soleil levant. \q Les gens verront {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire au-dessus de toi.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, giza litaifunika dunia, \q na giza nene mataifa; \q lakini juu yako {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atazuka, \q na utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utaonekana juu yako.
sw.B: Tazama: giza litaifunika dunia \q na weusi mzito utawalalia watu wa mataifa, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuzukia kama mapambazuko, \q na utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utaonekana juu yako.
sw.R: Tazama! Giza litaifunika dunia. \q Giza nene litawafunika watu wake. \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuangazia kama jua linalochomoza. \q Watu wataona utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu yako.

decisions.choice: deep darkness: thick, cloudy gloom
decisions.reason: The word is used of the dark cloud around God at Sinai (Exodus 20:21; Deuteronomy 4:11). Here it is darkness without God, lying on the peoples who do not know him.

decisions.choice: darkness on others but light on God's people: the picture of the plague of darkness in Egypt
decisions.reason: In Exodus 10:22-23 darkness covered Egypt, "but all the Israelites had light where they lived". Here the whole earth lies in darkness while the LORD himself rises over Zion.

decisions.choice: rise like the dawn / shine on you like the rising sun
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the sun rising (verse 1). Balanced and Readable make the picture of the sunrise explicit; Literal keeps "dawn".

source.text: וְהָלְכ֥וּ גוֹיִ֖ם לְאוֹרֵ֑ךְ וּמְלָכִ֖ים לְנֹ֥גַהּ זַרְחֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will walk nations to your light, and kings to [the] brightness of your dawning.

en.L: And nations will walk toward your light, \q and kings toward the shining of your dawn.
en.B: Nations will make their way to your light, \q and kings to the bright glow of your sunrise.
en.R: Nations will come to your light. \q Kings will come to the bright light of your new day.

es.L: Y caminarán las naciones hacia tu luz, \q y los reyes hacia el resplandor de tu amanecer.
es.B: Las naciones se encaminarán hacia tu luz, \q y los reyes hacia el brillo de tu aurora.
es.R: Las naciones vendrán a tu luz. \q Los reyes vendrán a la luz brillante de tu nuevo día.

fr.L: Et des nations marcheront vers ta lumière, \q et des rois vers l’éclat de ton lever.
fr.B: Des nations s’avanceront vers ta lumière, \q et des rois vers la clarté de ton aurore.
fr.R: Des nations viendront vers ta lumière. \q Des rois viendront vers la lumière éclatante de ton jour nouveau.

sw.L: Na mataifa watakwenda kwenye nuru yako, \q na wafalme kwenye mng'ao wa mapambazuko yako.
sw.B: Mataifa yatafuata njia kuja kwenye nuru yako, \q na wafalme kwenye mwanga mkali wa mawio yako.
sw.R: Mataifa yatakuja kwenye nuru yako. \q Wafalme watakuja kwenye mwanga mkali wa siku yako mpya.

decisions.choice: nations coming to Zion's light: the promise of 2:2-5 coming true
decisions.reason: In 2:2-3 many peoples stream to the mountain of the LORD's house, and Israel is called to "walk in the light of the LORD" (2:5). The servant is "a light for the nations" (42:6; 49:6). Revelation 21:24 echoes this verse: the nations walk by the city's light and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.

decisions.choice: the brightness of your dawn: the light that rises on Zion, not light she makes herself
decisions.reason: The word translated "dawn" comes from the verb "dawned" in verses 1-2. The light belongs to Zion because the LORD has risen on her.

source.text: שְׂאִֽי־סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֨יִךְ֙ וּרְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ־לָ֑ךְ בָּנַ֨יִךְ֙ מֵרָח֣וֹק יָבֹ֔אוּ וּבְנֹתַ֖יִךְ עַל־צַ֥ד תֵּאָמַֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift around your eyes and see: all of them have gathered, they have come to you; your sons from afar will come, and your daughters on [the] hip will be carried.

en.L: Lift up round about your eyes and see: \q all of them have gathered; they have come to you. \q Your sons from far away will come, \q and your daughters on [the] hip will be carried.
en.B: Look up and gaze around you: \q they are all gathering and coming to you. \q Your sons will arrive from far away, \q and your daughters will be carried on the hip like little children.
en.R: Look up and look all around you! \q Your people are all gathering and coming to you. \q Your sons are coming from far away. \q Your daughters are being carried in people's arms like small children.

es.L: Alza tus ojos alrededor y mira: \q todos ellos se han reunido; han venido a ti. \q Tus hijos vendrán de lejos, \q y tus hijas serán llevadas sobre la cadera.
es.B: Levanta la vista y mira a tu alrededor: \q todos se reúnen y vienen a ti. \q Tus hijos llegarán de lejos, \q y tus hijas serán llevadas en brazos como niñas pequeñas.
es.R: ¡Levanta la mirada y mira a tu alrededor! \q Toda tu gente se está reuniendo y viene a ti. \q Tus hijos vienen de lejos. \q A tus hijas las traen en brazos como a niñas pequeñas.

fr.L: Lève les yeux tout autour et regarde : \q tous se sont rassemblés ; ils sont venus vers toi. \q Tes fils viendront de loin, \q et tes filles seront portées sur la hanche.
fr.B: Lève les yeux et regarde autour de toi : \q ils se rassemblent tous et viennent vers toi. \q Tes fils arriveront de loin, \q et tes filles seront portées sur la hanche comme de petits enfants.
fr.R: Lève les yeux et regarde tout autour de toi ! \q Tous les tiens se rassemblent et viennent vers toi. \q Tes fils arrivent de loin. \q Tes filles sont portées dans les bras comme de petits enfants.

sw.L: Inua macho yako pande zote uone: \q wote wamekusanyika; wamekuja kwako. \q Wana wako watakuja kutoka mbali, \q na binti zako watabebwa nyongani.
sw.B: Inua macho utazame pande zote: \q wote wanakusanyika na kuja kwako. \q Wana wako watafika kutoka mbali, \q na binti zako watabebwa nyongani kama watoto wadogo.
sw.R: Tazama juu, uangalie pande zote! \q Watu wako wote wanakusanyika na kuja kwako. \q Wana wako wanakuja kutoka mbali. \q Binti zako wanabebwa mikononi mwa watu kama watoto wadogo.

decisions.choice: the first half repeats 49:18 almost word for word: Zion's scattered children coming home
decisions.reason: In 49:18-22 Zion, who thought herself childless, sees her children gathering, and the nations carry her sons and daughters back to her. The sons and daughters are the exiled people of Israel returning.

decisions.choice: carried on the hip: carried as a nurse carries a small child
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for a nurse or guardian who carries a child (Numbers 11:12; Ruth 4:16; 49:23). The same picture of being carried on the hip returns in 66:12.

decisions.choice: Your people are all gathering
decisions.reason: Readable names who "all of them" are: Zion's sons and daughters, as the next lines say.

source.text: אָ֤ז תִּרְאִי֙ וְנָהַ֔רְתְּ וּפָחַ֥ד וְרָחַ֖ב לְבָבֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־יֵהָפֵ֤ךְ עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ הֲמ֣וֹן יָ֔ם חֵ֥יל גּוֹיִ֖ם יָבֹ֥אוּ לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Then you will see and be radiant, and will tremble and be enlarged your heart, for will be turned over to you [the] abundance of [the] sea; [the] wealth of nations will come to you.

en.L: Then you will see and glow, \q and your heart will tremble and grow wide, \q for the abundance of the sea will be turned over to you; \q the wealth of nations will come to you.
en.B: Then you will look, and your face will glow; \q your heart will tremble and open wide, \q because the riches of the sea will be poured out on you \q and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
en.R: When you see this, your face will shine with joy. \q Your heart will tremble with wonder and be full of joy. \q The riches that sail across the sea will be brought to you. \q The wealth of the nations will come to you.

es.L: Entonces verás y resplandecerás, \q y tu corazón se estremecerá y se ensanchará, \q porque la abundancia del mar se volcará sobre ti; \q la riqueza de las naciones vendrá a ti.
es.B: Entonces mirarás, y tu rostro brillará; \q tu corazón temblará y se abrirá de par en par, \q porque las riquezas del mar se derramarán sobre ti \q y la riqueza de las naciones vendrá a ti.
es.R: Cuando veas esto, tu cara brillará de alegría. \q Tu corazón temblará de asombro y se llenará de gozo. \q Te traerán las riquezas que navegan por el mar. \q La riqueza de las naciones vendrá a ti.

fr.L: Alors tu verras et tu seras radieuse, \q et ton cœur tressaillira et s’élargira, \q car l’abondance de la mer se tournera vers toi ; \q la richesse des nations viendra à toi.
fr.B: Alors tu regarderas, et ton visage s’illuminera ; \q ton cœur frémira et s’ouvrira tout grand, \q car les richesses de la mer afflueront vers toi \q et la fortune des nations viendra jusqu’à toi.
fr.R: Quand tu verras cela, ton visage brillera de joie. \q Ton cœur tremblera d’émerveillement et sera rempli de joie. \q Les richesses transportées par la mer te seront apportées. \q Les richesses des nations viendront jusqu’à toi.

sw.L: Ndipo utaona na kung'aa, \q na moyo wako utatetemeka na kupanuka, \q kwa maana wingi wa bahari utageuzwa kwako; \q utajiri wa mataifa utakuja kwako.
sw.B: Ndipo utatazama, na uso wako utang'aa; \q moyo wako utatetemeka na kufunguka kwa upana, \q kwa sababu utajiri wa bahari utamiminwa juu yako \q na mali ya mataifa itakuja kwako.
sw.R: Utakapoona hayo, uso wako utang'aa kwa furaha. \q Moyo wako utatetemeka kwa mshangao na kujaa furaha. \q Utajiri unaosafirishwa baharini utaletwa kwako. \q Mali ya mataifa itakuja kwako.

decisions.choice: glow; tremble; grow wide: a face lit up with joy and a heart trembling and overflowing with it
decisions.reason: The verb "glow" is used of faces that look to the LORD and shine (Psalm 34:6). "Tremble" usually means fear, but here it is the trembling of excitement at good news (Jeremiah 33:9; Hosea 3:5). A heart made wide is one filled with joy (Psalm 119:32).

decisions.choice: the abundance of the sea: the riches carried by sea trade
decisions.reason: The word means a great quantity, a wealth. The next line and verse 9 show the goods brought by ships from across the sea.

decisions.choice: with wonder ... full of joy
decisions.reason: Readable states the feeling behind the trembling and the widened heart (see m1).

source.text: שִֽׁפְעַ֨ת גְּמַלִּ֜ים תְּכַסֵּ֗ךְ בִּכְרֵ֤י מִדְיָן֙ וְעֵיפָ֔ה כֻּלָּ֖ם מִשְּׁבָ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ זָהָ֤ב וּלְבוֹנָה֙ יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּתְהִלֹּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יְבַשֵּֽׂרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: An abundance of camels will cover you, young camels of Midian and Ephah; all of them from Sheba will come; gold and frankincense they will carry, and the praises of Yahweh they will bear as news.

en.L: A throng of camels will cover you, young camels of Midian and Ephah; \q all of them from Sheba will come; \q gold and frankincense they will carry, \q and the praises of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} they will announce.
en.B: Caravans of camels will fill your land, young camels from Midian and Ephah. \q Everyone from Sheba will come, \q bringing gold and frankincense \q and announcing the deeds of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that deserve praise.
en.R: Great numbers of camels will fill your land. \q Young camels will come from Midian and Ephah. \q People will come from Sheba carrying gold and costly incense. \q They will tell the good news about the great things {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done.

es.L: Multitud de camellos te cubrirá, camellos jóvenes de Madián y de Efá; \q todos ellos vendrán de Sabá; \q oro e incienso traerán, \q y las alabanzas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} anunciarán.
es.B: Caravanas de camellos llenarán tu tierra, camellos jóvenes de Madián y de Efá. \q Todos los de Sabá vendrán, \q trayendo oro e incienso \q y anunciando las obras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dignas de alabanza.
es.R: Grandes cantidades de camellos llenarán tu tierra. \q Vendrán camellos jóvenes de Madián y de Efá. \q La gente vendrá de Sabá cargando oro e incienso costoso. \q Contarán la buena noticia de las grandes cosas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho.

fr.L: Une multitude de chameaux te couvrira, de jeunes chameaux de Madian et d’Épha ; \q tous viendront de Saba ; \q ils apporteront l’or et l’encens, \q et ils annonceront les louanges {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Des caravanes de chameaux rempliront ton pays, de jeunes chameaux de Madian et d’Épha. \q Tous les gens de Saba viendront, \q apportant de l’or et de l’encens \q et proclamant les hauts faits {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dignes de louange.
fr.R: De très nombreux chameaux rempliront ton pays. \q De jeunes chameaux viendront de Madian et d’Épha. \q Des gens viendront de Saba avec de l’or et un encens précieux. \q Ils annonceront la bonne nouvelle des grandes choses que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a faites.

sw.L: Wingi wa ngamia utakufunika, ngamia wachanga wa Midiani na Efa; \q wote watakuja kutoka Sheba; \q dhahabu na ubani watabeba, \q na sifa za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watazitangaza.
sw.B: Misafara ya ngamia itaijaza nchi yako, ngamia wachanga kutoka Midiani na Efa. \q Watu wote wa Sheba watakuja, \q wakileta dhahabu na ubani, \q na kutangaza matendo ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yanayostahili sifa.
sw.R: Ngamia wengi sana wataijaza nchi yako. \q Ngamia wachanga watakuja kutoka Midiani na Efa. \q Watu watakuja kutoka Sheba wakibeba dhahabu na ubani wa thamani. \q Watatangaza habari njema za mambo makuu ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefanya.

decisions.choice: Midian, Ephah and Sheba: Arabian peoples known for caravans and trade
decisions.reason: Midian and Ephah were tribes of the Arabian desert east of Israel; Ephah was a son of Midian (Genesis 25:2-4). Sheba lay in southern Arabia and was famous for gold and spices (1 Kings 10:1-2; Psalm 72:10, 15; Jeremiah 6:20). Frankincense is a fragrant resin burned in worship (Exodus 30:34).

decisions.choice: announce the praises of the LORD: bring the good news of what the LORD has done that deserves praise
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of bringing good news in 40:9; 52:7; 61:1. "Praises" can mean the praiseworthy deeds themselves (Psalm 78:4). Gold and frankincense are also the gifts of the wise men from the east in Matthew 2:11.

decisions.choice: costly incense
decisions.reason: Readable describes frankincense as a costly incense rather than using the less familiar name.

source.text: כָּל־צֹ֤אן קֵדָר֙ יִקָּ֣בְצוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵילֵ֥י נְבָי֖וֹת יְשָׁרְת֑וּנֶךְ יַעֲל֤וּ עַל־רָצוֹן֙ מִזְבְּחִ֔י וּבֵ֥ית תִּפְאַרְתִּ֖י אֲפָאֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; [the] rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will go up with acceptance [on] my altar, and [the] house of my beauty I will beautify.

en.L: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; \q the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; \q they will go up with acceptance [on] {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, \q and the house of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beauty I will make beautiful.
en.B: Every flock of Kedar will be herded to you, \q and the rams of Nebaioth will be at your service. \q They will be offered on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar and I will accept them, \q and I will adorn the house that is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} splendor.
en.R: All the sheep of Kedar will be brought to you. \q The rams of Nebaioth will be yours to use. \q They will be offered on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} altar, and I will accept them. \q I will make {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beautiful temple even more beautiful.

es.L: Todos los rebaños de Cedar se reunirán junto a ti; \q los carneros de Nebaiot estarán a tu servicio; \q subirán con agrado [sobre] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, \q y la casa de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria embelleceré.
es.B: Todo rebaño de Cedar será conducido hacia ti, \q y los carneros de Nebaiot estarán a tu servicio. \q Serán ofrecidos sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar y yo los aceptaré, \q y embelleceré la casa que es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esplendor.
es.R: Todas las ovejas de Cedar serán traídas a ti. \q Los carneros de Nebaiot serán tuyos para que los uses. \q Serán ofrecidos sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} altar, y yo los aceptaré. \q Haré que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hermoso templo sea aún más hermoso.

fr.L: Tous les troupeaux de Kédar seront rassemblés vers toi ; \q les béliers de Nebayoth te serviront ; \q ils monteront agréés [sur] {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel, \q et la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur, je la rendrai splendide.
fr.B: Tous les troupeaux de Kédar seront conduits vers toi, \q et les béliers de Nebayoth seront à ton service. \q Ils seront offerts sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel, et je les accepterai, \q et j’embellirai la maison qui fait {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur.
fr.R: Tous les moutons de Kédar te seront amenés. \q Tu pourras te servir des béliers de Nebayoth. \q Ils seront offerts sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} autel, et je les accepterai. \q Je rendrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} beau temple encore plus beau.

sw.L: Makundi yote ya Kedari yatakusanywa kwako; \q kondoo dume wa Nebayothi watakutumikia; \q watapanda kwa kibali [juu ya] madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q nami nitaipamba nyumba ya fahari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Kila kundi la Kedari litaswagwa kwako, \q na kondoo dume wa Nebayothi watakuwa tayari kukutumikia. \q Watatolewa juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, nami nitawakubali, \q nami nitaipamba nyumba iliyo fahari {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Kondoo wote wa Kedari wataletwa kwako. \q Kondoo dume wa Nebayothi watakuwa wako kuwatumia. \q Watatolewa sadaka juu ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, nami nitawakubali. \q Nitalifanya hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} zuri kuwa zuri zaidi.

decisions.choice: Kedar and Nebaioth: Arab tribes of herders, descended from Ishmael
decisions.reason: Nebaioth and Kedar were the first two sons of Ishmael (Genesis 25:13). Kedar's tribes lived in tents and kept large flocks (21:16-17; Jeremiah 49:28-29; Ezekiel 27:21).

decisions.choice: serve you; go up with acceptance: the animals will be available for Zion's sacrifices, and God will accept them
decisions.reason: "Go up" is the verb used for offerings rising on the altar. The word "acceptance" (also "favor" in verse 10 and 61:2) means God receives the offering with goodwill, as 56:7 promises for the offerings of foreigners.

decisions.choice: my beautiful temple
decisions.reason: Readable says that "the house of my beauty" is the temple, as verse 13 shows.

source.text: מִי־אֵ֖לֶּה כָּעָ֣ב תְּעוּפֶ֑ינָה וְכַיּוֹנִ֖ים אֶל־אֲרֻבֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [are] these [that] like a cloud fly, and like doves to their windows?

en.L: Who [are] these? Like a cloud they fly, \q and like doves to their openings.
en.B: Who are these, speeding along like a cloud, \q like doves returning to their roosting holes?
en.R: Who are these, flying along like a cloud, \q like doves flying home to their nests?

es.L: ¿Quiénes [son] estos? Como nube vuelan, \q y como palomas a sus aberturas.
es.B: ¿Quiénes son estos, que vuelan veloces como una nube, \q como palomas que vuelven a los agujeros de su palomar?
es.R: ¿Quiénes son estos que vuelan como una nube, \q como palomas que vuelan a casa, a sus nidos?

fr.L: Qui [sont] ceux-ci ? Comme une nuée ils volent, \q et comme des colombes vers leurs ouvertures.
fr.B: Qui sont ceux-là qui filent comme une nuée, \q comme des colombes qui regagnent leur colombier ?
fr.R: Qui sont ceux-là qui volent comme un nuage, \q comme des colombes qui rentrent à leur nid ?

sw.L: Ni nani hawa? Kama wingu wanaruka, \q na kama hua kwenye madirisha yao.
sw.B: Ni nani hawa wanaokwenda kasi kama wingu, \q kama hua wanaorudi kwenye vitundu vyao?
sw.R: Ni nani hawa wanaoruka kama wingu, \q kama hua wanaoruka kurudi kwenye viota vyao?

decisions.choice: who are these: the ships of verse 9, coming with sails spread, bringing Zion's children
decisions.reason: Verse 9 answers the question with the ships of Tarshish carrying Zion's children home. Their white sails crowding the horizon look like a cloud, or like a flock of doves. Some take "these" to be the returning people themselves rather than the ships; the picture is the same.

decisions.choice: their openings: the holes of a dovecote
decisions.reason: The word means a lattice or opening (Genesis 7:11 uses it for the "windows" of the sky). Here it is the small openings through which doves fly home into the dovecote.

source.text: כִּֽי־לִ֣י׀אִיִּ֣ים יְקַוּ֗וּ וָאֳנִיּ֤וֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ֙ בָּרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה לְהָבִ֤יא בָנַ֨יִךְ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק כַּסְפָּ֥ם וּזְהָבָ֖ם אִתָּ֑ם לְשֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִךְ וְלִקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֥י פֵאֲרָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For for me [the] coastlands will wait, and [the] ships of Tarshish at the first, to bring your sons from afar, their silver and their gold with them, to [the] name of Yahweh your God and to [the] Holy One of Israel, for he has glorified you.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the coastlands will wait, and the ships of Tarshish [are] first, \q to bring your sons from far away, \q their silver and their gold with them, \q for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God \q and for the Holy One of Israel, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made you glorious.
en.B: The coastlands wait in hope for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; the ships of Tarshish sail first, \q carrying your children home from distant places, \q and their silver and gold along with them, \q for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, \q for the Holy One of Israel, since {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made you glorious.
en.R: People in lands far away are waiting for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. The great trading ships lead the way. \q They are carrying your children home from far away. \q They bring their silver and gold with them \q to honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, the Holy One of Israel. \q He has made you glorious.

es.L: Porque a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} esperarán las costas, y las naves de Tarsis [van] primero, \q para traer a tus hijos de lejos, \q su plata y su oro con ellos, \q para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios \q y para el Santo de Israel, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ha glorificado.
es.B: Las costas lejanas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} esperan con esperanza; las naves de Tarsis navegan al frente, \q trayendo a tus hijos a casa desde lugares lejanos, \q y su plata y su oro con ellos, \q para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios, \q para el Santo de Israel, que te ha llenado de gloria.
es.R: La gente de las tierras lejanas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} está esperando. Los grandes barcos mercantes van al frente. \q Traen a tus hijos de vuelta a casa desde lejos. \q Traen con ellos su plata y su oro \q para honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, el Santo de Israel. \q Él te ha llenado de gloria.

fr.L: Car les îles {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}attendront, et les navires de Tarsis [sont] en tête, \q pour ramener tes fils de loin, \q leur argent et leur or avec eux, \q pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu \q et pour le Saint d’Israël, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a glorifiée.
fr.B: Les îles lointaines espèrent en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; les navires de Tarsis ouvrent la marche, \q ramenant tes enfants des pays lointains, \q et avec eux leur argent et leur or, \q pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu, \q pour le Saint d’Israël, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a glorifiée.
fr.R: Les gens des pays lointains {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}attendent. Les grands navires de commerce ouvrent la route. \q Ils ramènent tes enfants de loin. \q Ils apportent avec eux leur argent et leur or \q pour honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu, le Saint d’Israël. \q Il t’a rendue glorieuse.

sw.L: Kwa maana visiwa vitaningojea, na merikebu za Tarshishi [ziko] mbele, \q kuwaleta wana wako kutoka mbali, \q fedha yao na dhahabu yao pamoja nao, \q kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako \q na kwa ajili ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli, kwa sababu amekutukuza.
sw.B: Pwani za mbali zinanitazamia kwa matumaini; merikebu za Tarshishi zinatangulia, \q zikiwaleta watoto wako nyumbani kutoka mahali pa mbali, \q pamoja na fedha yao na dhahabu yao, \q kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, \q kwa ajili ya Mtakatifu wa Israeli, kwa kuwa amekutukuza.
sw.R: Watu wa nchi za mbali ng'ambo ya bahari wananisubiri. Meli kubwa za biashara zinaongoza njia. \q Zinawaleta watoto wako nyumbani kutoka mbali. \q Wanakuja na fedha na dhahabu yao \q ili kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, Mtakatifu wa Israeli. \q Yeye amekutukuza.

decisions.choice: the coastlands will wait for me: the distant lands look to God in hope
alternatives: the coastlands will gather to me
decisions.reason: The same words appear in 51:5, and in 42:4 the coastlands wait for the servant's instruction. The verb usually means to wait with hope; it has also been read here as "gather", from a verb that looks the same (Genesis 1:9).

decisions.choice: the ships of Tarshish first: the great seagoing ships in the lead
alternatives: the ships of Tarshish, as at the first
decisions.reason: Ships of Tarshish were the largest trading ships, built for long voyages (2:16; 23:1; 1 Kings 10:22). Once a sign of proud wealth that God would bring low (2:16), they now carry Zion's children and riches to her.

decisions.choice: your children
decisions.reason: The word is "sons", but here it means all of Zion's children; verse 4 already named sons and daughters. Literal keeps "sons".

decisions.choice: naves de Tarsis (L, B); grandes barcos mercantes (R)
decisions.reason: Book-wide for *oniyyot tarshish* in this block, as 1 Kings 10:22 and 22:49 and the terms note.

decisions.choice: merikebu za Tarshishi (Literal, Balanced); meli kubwa za biashara (Readable)
decisions.reason: Ships of Tarshish as in Psalm 48:8; Readable says what they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "les navires de Tarsis" (L, B), "les grands navires de commerce" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 10:22 and the terms note: the name at Literal and Balanced, the kind of ship at Readable.

source.text: וּבָנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־נֵכָר֙ חֹמֹתַ֔יִךְ וּמַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם יְשָׁרְת֑וּנֶךְ כִּ֤י בְקִצְפִּי֙ הִכִּיתִ֔יךְ וּבִרְצוֹנִ֖י רִֽחַמְתִּֽיךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And sons of foreignness will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, and in my favor I have had compassion on you.

en.L: And sons of a foreign land will build your walls, \q and their kings will serve you; \q for in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath I struck you, \q and in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} favor I have shown you compassion.
en.B: People from foreign lands will rebuild your walls, \q and their kings will wait on you. \q In {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I struck you down, \q but in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} goodwill I have shown you tender mercy.
en.R: People from other countries will build your walls again. \q Their kings will serve you. \q I punished you when I was angry. \q But now I am pleased with you, and I have shown you mercy.

es.L: Y hijos de extranjeros edificarán tus muros, \q y sus reyes te servirán; \q porque en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira te herí, \q y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} favor he tenido compasión de ti.
es.B: Gente de tierras extranjeras reconstruirá tus muros, \q y sus reyes estarán a tu servicio. \q En {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo te castigué, \q pero en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} buena voluntad te he mostrado tierna misericordia.
es.R: Gente de otros países volverá a construir tus muros. \q Sus reyes te servirán. \q Te castigué cuando estaba enojado. \q Pero ahora estoy contento contigo, y te he mostrado misericordia.

fr.L: Et des fils de l’étranger bâtiront tes murailles, \q et leurs rois te serviront ; \q car dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère je t’ai frappée, \q et dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} faveur j’ai eu compassion de toi.
fr.B: Des gens de pays étrangers rebâtiront tes murailles, \q et leurs rois se mettront à ton service. \q Dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère je t’ai frappée, \q mais dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bienveillance je t’ai montré {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} tendresse.
fr.R: Des gens d’autres pays reconstruiront tes murailles. \q Leurs rois te serviront. \q Je t’ai punie quand j’étais en colère. \q Mais maintenant je suis content de toi, et je t’ai montré {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} bonté.

sw.L: Na wana wa nchi ya kigeni watajenga kuta zako, \q na wafalme wao watakutumikia; \q kwa maana katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nilikupiga, \q na katika kibali {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} nimekuhurumia.
sw.B: Watu kutoka nchi za kigeni watazijenga upya kuta zako, \q na wafalme wao watakuhudumia. \q Katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} nilikupiga, \q lakini katika fadhili {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} nimekuonyesha huruma nyororo.
sw.R: Watu kutoka nchi nyingine watajenga kuta zako tena. \q Wafalme wao watakutumikia. \q Nilikuadhibu nilipokasirika. \q Lakini sasa ninapendezwa nawe, nami nimekuonyesha huruma.

decisions.choice: in wrath I struck you, in favor I have had compassion: the exile was God's judgment, but his last word is mercy
decisions.reason: God's anger was real but brief, and his compassion lasts (54:7-8; 57:16-18). The word "favor" is the same as "acceptance" in verse 7 and the "year of favor" in 61:2.

decisions.choice: foreigners rebuilding the walls and kings serving: the nations that once destroyed Jerusalem now help restore it
decisions.reason: Babylon broke down the walls of Jerusalem (2 Kings 25:10). Here foreigners rebuild them, as in 49:23 kings become Zion's caretakers. The Persian king Cyrus ordered the temple rebuilt (44:28; Ezra 1:2-4).

decisions.choice: now I am pleased with you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in my favor" as God being pleased with Zion, and adds "now" to mark the change from anger.

source.text: וּפִתְּח֨וּ שְׁעָרַ֧יִךְ תָּמִ֛יד יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֖יְלָה לֹ֣א יִסָּגֵ֑רוּ לְהָבִ֤יא אֵלַ֨יִךְ֙ חֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֔ם וּמַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם נְהוּגִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be open your gates continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring to you [the] wealth of nations, and their kings led.

en.L: And your gates will stand open always; by day and by night they will not be shut, \q so as to bring to you [the] wealth of nations, \q and their kings being led.
en.B: Your gates will never be closed; day and night they will be left open, \q so that the riches of the nations may be carried in to you, \q with their kings brought along in the procession.
en.R: Your gates will always be open. They will not be shut day or night. \q Then the nations can bring their riches to you. \q Their kings will be led in with them.

es.L: Y tus puertas estarán abiertas continuamente; de día y de noche no se cerrarán, \q para traerte la riqueza de las naciones, \q y a sus reyes conducidos.
es.B: Tus puertas nunca se cerrarán; de día y de noche quedarán abiertas, \q para que te traigan las riquezas de las naciones, \q con sus reyes en la procesión.
es.R: Tus puertas siempre estarán abiertas. No se cerrarán ni de día ni de noche. \q Así las naciones podrán traerte sus riquezas. \q Sus reyes entrarán guiados con ellas.

fr.L: Et tes portes seront ouvertes continuellement ; jour et nuit elles ne seront pas fermées, \q pour faire venir chez toi la richesse des nations, \q et leurs rois conduits [en cortège].
fr.B: Tes portes ne seront jamais fermées ; jour et nuit on les laissera ouvertes, \q afin qu’on t’apporte les richesses des nations, \q avec leurs rois menés en cortège.
fr.R: Tes portes seront toujours ouvertes. On ne les fermera ni le jour ni la nuit. \q Alors les nations pourront t’apporter leurs richesses. \q On fera entrer leurs rois avec elles.

sw.L: Na malango yako yatakuwa wazi daima; mchana na usiku hayatafungwa, \q ili kukuletea utajiri wa mataifa, \q na wafalme wao wakiongozwa.
sw.B: Malango yako hayatafungwa kamwe; mchana na usiku yataachwa wazi, \q ili mali ya mataifa iletwe ndani kwako, \q pamoja na wafalme wao wakiletwa katika msafara.
sw.R: Malango yako yatakuwa wazi siku zote. Hayatafungwa mchana wala usiku. \q Ndipo mataifa yataweza kukuletea mali zao. \q Wafalme wao wataongozwa ndani pamoja nao.

decisions.choice: their kings led: the kings brought in a procession
decisions.reason: The word means "led" or "guided". It may picture kings led in as captives, or kings in a procession bringing tribute. The verse does not say which.

decisions.choice: gates never shut: a city with no enemy to fear, open to receive the nations
decisions.reason: City gates were shut at night and in danger (Joshua 2:5; Nehemiah 7:3). Revelation 21:25-26 echoes this verse: the gates of the new Jerusalem are never shut, and the glory of the nations is brought into it.

source.text: כִּֽי־הַגּ֧וֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יַעַבְד֖וּךְ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְהַגּוֹיִ֖ם חָרֹ֥ב יֶחֱרָֽבוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the nation and the kingdom that will not serve you will perish, and the nations utterly will be laid waste.

en.L: For the nation and the kingdom that will not serve you will perish, \q and those nations will be utterly laid waste.
en.B: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be destroyed; \q such nations will be left in complete ruin.
en.R: Any nation or kingdom that will not serve you will be destroyed. \q Those nations will be completely ruined.

es.L: Porque la nación y el reino que no te sirvan perecerán, \q y esas naciones serán del todo asoladas.
es.B: Cualquier nación o reino que se niegue a servirte será destruido; \q esas naciones quedarán en ruina total.
es.R: Cualquier nación o reino que no te sirva será destruido. \q Esas naciones quedarán completamente arruinadas.

fr.L: Car la nation et le royaume qui ne te serviront pas périront, \q et ces nations seront entièrement dévastées.
fr.B: Toute nation, tout royaume qui refusera de te servir sera détruit ; \q ces nations seront livrées à une ruine complète.
fr.R: Toute nation, tout royaume qui ne te servira pas sera détruit. \q Ces nations seront complètement ruinées.

sw.L: Kwa maana taifa na ufalme usiokutumikia utaangamia, \q na mataifa hayo yataharibiwa kabisa.
sw.B: Taifa lolote au ufalme wowote unaokataa kukutumikia utaangamizwa; \q mataifa kama hayo yataachwa katika maangamizi kamili.
sw.R: Taifa lolote au ufalme wowote usiokutumikia utaangamizwa. \q Mataifa hayo yataharibiwa kabisa.

decisions.choice: utterly laid waste: the verb is doubled for emphasis
decisions.reason: Hebrew repeats the verb in another form to strengthen it: "laid waste, laid waste". The warning shows that Zion's honor comes from God and that refusing it is refusing him (compare Zechariah 14:17-19).

source.text: כְּב֤וֹד הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ אֵלַ֣יִךְ יָב֔וֹא בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּתְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּ֑ו לְפָאֵר֙ מְק֣וֹם מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וּמְק֥וֹם רַגְלַ֖י אֲכַבֵּֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: The glory of Lebanon to you will come, cypress, elm and box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and the place of my feet I will glorify.

en.L: The glory of Lebanon will come to you, \q juniper, elm and box tree together, \q to beautify the place of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary; \q and the place of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet I will make glorious.
en.B: The glory of Lebanon will be brought to you, \q the juniper, the elm and the box tree side by side, \q to adorn the site of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sanctuary, \q and I will bring honor to the place where {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet rest.
en.R: The glory of Lebanon will come to you: \q its finest junipers, elms and box trees. \q They will make the place of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple beautiful. \q I will bring honor to the place where I rest {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} feet.

es.L: La gloria del Líbano vendrá a ti, \q el enebro, el olmo y el boj juntamente, \q para embellecer el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario; \q y el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies glorificaré.
es.B: La gloria del Líbano te será traída, \q el enebro, el olmo y el boj, uno junto a otro, \q para adornar el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santuario, \q y daré honra al lugar donde reposan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies.
es.R: La gloria del Líbano vendrá a ti: \q sus mejores enebros, olmos y bojes. \q Harán hermoso el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo. \q Daré honra al lugar donde descanso {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pies.

fr.L: La gloire du Liban viendra à toi, \q le genévrier, l’orme et le buis ensemble, \q pour embellir le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire ; \q et le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds, je le glorifierai.
fr.B: La gloire du Liban te sera apportée, \q le genévrier, l’orme et le buis côte à côte, \q pour orner l’emplacement de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sanctuaire, \q et je rendrai glorieux le lieu où reposent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds.
fr.R: La gloire du Liban viendra jusqu’à toi : \q ses plus beaux genévriers, ses ormes et ses buis. \q Ils rendront beau l’endroit où se trouve {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple. \q J’honorerai l’endroit où je pose {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} pieds.

sw.L: Utukufu wa Lebanoni utakujia, \q mreteni, msonobari na mberoshi pamoja, \q kupamba mahali pa patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}; \q nami nitapatukuza mahali pa miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Utukufu wa Lebanoni utaletwa kwako, \q mreteni, msonobari na mberoshi kando kwa kando, \q kupamba mahali pa patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, \q nami nitapaheshimu mahali ambapo miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hupumzika.
sw.R: Utukufu wa Lebanoni utakujia: \q mireteni yake, misonobari na miberoshi iliyo bora kuliko yote. \q Vitapafanya mahali pa hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kuwa pazuri. \q Nitapaheshimu mahali ninapoweka miguu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

decisions.choice: the glory of Lebanon: its great forests, whose timber built and adorned the temple
decisions.reason: Solomon built the first temple with cedar and juniper from Lebanon (1 Kings 5:20-24). The same three trees are planted in the wilderness in 41:19. The exact kinds of tree are not certain; the names follow 41:19.

decisions.choice: the place of my feet: the temple as God's footstool
decisions.reason: The temple, and the ark within it, is called the footstool of God's feet (Psalm 99:5; 132:7; 1 Chronicles 28:2; Lamentations 2:1). In 66:1 the whole earth is his footstool.

source.text: וְהָלְכ֨וּ אֵלַ֤יִךְ שְׁח֨וֹחַ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְעַנַּ֔יִךְ וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ עַל־כַּפּ֥וֹת רַגְלַ֖יִךְ כָּל־מְנַֽאֲצָ֑יִךְ וְקָ֤רְאוּ לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר יְהוָ֔ה צִיּ֖וֹן קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And will come to you bowing [the] sons of [those who] afflicted you, and will bow down at [the] soles of your feet all [who] despised you, and they will call you City of Yahweh, Zion of [the] Holy One of Israel.

en.L: And the sons of those who afflicted you will come to you bowing low, \q and all who despised you will bow down at the soles of your feet; \q and they will call you the City of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
en.B: The children of those who oppressed you will come to you with heads bowed; \q everyone who looked down on you will fall at your feet. \q They will name you City of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
en.R: The children of the people who made you suffer will come and bow low in front of you. \q All who hated you will bow down at your feet. \q They will call you the City of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

es.L: Y vendrán a ti humillados los hijos de los que te afligieron, \q y se postrarán a las plantas de tus pies todos los que te despreciaban; \q y te llamarán Ciudad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q Sion del Santo de Israel.
es.B: Los hijos de los que te oprimieron vendrán a ti con la cabeza inclinada; \q todos los que te miraban con desprecio caerán a tus pies. \q Te darán el nombre de Ciudad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q Sion del Santo de Israel.
es.R: Los hijos de la gente que te hizo sufrir vendrán y se inclinarán ante ti. \q Todos los que te odiaban se inclinarán a tus pies. \q Te llamarán la Ciudad {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q la Sion del Santo de Israel.

fr.L: Et les fils de ceux qui t’opprimaient viendront à toi en se courbant, \q et tous ceux qui te méprisaient se prosterneront à la plante de tes pieds ; \q et ils t’appelleront Ville {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q Sion du Saint d’Israël.
fr.B: Les enfants de ceux qui t’opprimaient viendront à toi la tête basse ; \q tous ceux qui te regardaient de haut tomberont à tes pieds. \q Ils t’appelleront Ville {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q Sion du Saint d’Israël.
fr.R: Les enfants des gens qui t’ont fait souffrir viendront se courber devant toi. \q Tous ceux qui te détestaient se prosterneront à tes pieds. \q Ils t’appelleront la Ville {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q la Sion du Saint d’Israël.

sw.L: Na wana wa wale waliokutesa watakujia wakiinama, \q na wote waliokudharau watasujudu kwenye nyayo za miguu yako; \q nao watakuita Mji wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q Sayuni wa Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Watoto wa wale waliokuonea watakuja kwako wakiinamisha vichwa; \q kila mmoja aliyekudharau ataanguka miguuni pako. \q Watakuita Mji wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q Sayuni wa Mtakatifu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Watoto wa watu waliokutesa watakuja na kuinama mbele yako. \q Wote waliokuchukia watasujudu miguuni pako. \q Watakuita Mji wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q Sayuni wa Mtakatifu wa Israeli.

decisions.choice: bowing at your feet: a reversal of Zion's humiliation
decisions.reason: Those who once trampled Zion now honor her (49:23; 45:14). Revelation 3:9 uses the same picture for the church in Philadelphia.

decisions.choice: City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel: new names saying whom the city belongs to
decisions.reason: A new name marks a new standing. Zion receives such names again in 1:26; 60:18; 62:2-4, 12. "Zion of the Holy One of Israel" means the Zion that belongs to Israel's Holy God.

source.text: תַּ֧חַת הֱיוֹתֵ֛ךְ עֲזוּבָ֥ה וּשְׂנוּאָ֖ה וְאֵ֣ין עוֹבֵ֑ר וְשַׂמְתִּיךְ֙ לִגְא֣וֹן עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֖וֹשׂ דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: In place of your being forsaken and hated, and there was no one passing through, I will make you an exaltation of perpetuity, a joy of generation and generation.

en.L: In place of your being forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, \q I will make you a pride forever, \q a joy of generation and generation.
en.B: You were abandoned and despised, a place no traveler would cross; \q but I will make you a source of pride for all time, \q a delight to one generation after another.
en.R: You were left alone and hated. No one even traveled through your land. \q But I will make you great forever. \q You will be a joy to people in every generation.

es.L: En lugar de haber sido abandonada y aborrecida, sin que nadie pasara [por ti], \q te haré orgullo eterno, \q gozo de generación en generación.
es.B: Estabas abandonada y despreciada, un lugar que ningún viajero cruzaba; \q pero haré de ti un motivo de orgullo para siempre, \q una alegría para una generación tras otra.
es.R: Estabas sola y odiada. Nadie pasaba siquiera por tu tierra. \q Pero te haré grande para siempre. \q Serás una alegría para la gente de cada generación.

fr.L: Au lieu que tu sois abandonnée et haïe, sans personne qui passe, \q je ferai de toi un orgueil éternel, \q une joie de génération en génération.
fr.B: Tu étais abandonnée et méprisée, un lieu que nul voyageur ne traversait ; \q mais je ferai de toi un sujet de fierté pour toujours, \q une joie pour chaque génération.
fr.R: Tu étais abandonnée et détestée. Personne ne passait même dans ton pays. \q Mais je te rendrai grande pour toujours. \q Tu seras une joie pour les gens de chaque génération.

sw.L: Badala ya kuwa kwako umeachwa na kuchukiwa, bila mtu wa kupita, \q nitakufanya fahari ya milele, \q furaha ya kizazi hata kizazi.
sw.B: Ulikuwa umeachwa na kudharauliwa, mahali ambapo hakuna msafiri aliyepita; \q lakini nitakufanya chanzo cha fahari kwa nyakati zote, \q furaha kwa kizazi kimoja baada ya kingine.
sw.R: Ulikuwa umeachwa peke yako na kuchukiwa. Hakuna aliyepita hata katika nchi yako. \q Lakini nitakufanya uwe mkuu milele. \q Utakuwa furaha kwa watu wa kila kizazi.

decisions.choice: forsaken and hated: words used of an abandoned and unloved wife
decisions.reason: Zion is pictured as a wife who thought herself abandoned (49:14; 54:6). "Hated" is used of a wife who is not loved (Genesis 29:31; Deuteronomy 21:15). In 62:4 she will no longer be called "Forsaken".

decisions.choice: no one passing through: the city lay deserted after its fall
decisions.reason: Roads and streets with no travelers mark a ruined land (33:8; Lamentations 1:4).

source.text: וְיָנַקְתְּ֙ חֲלֵ֣ב גּוֹיִ֔ם וְשֹׁ֥ד מְלָכִ֖ים תִּינָ֑קִי וְיָדַ֗עַתְּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔ךְ וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will suck [the] milk of nations, and [the] breast of kings you will suck; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh your deliverer, and your redeemer [is the] Mighty One of Jacob.

en.L: And you will suck the milk of nations, \q and the breast of kings you will suck; \q and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, your Savior, \q and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
en.B: Nations will feed you with their milk, \q and kings will nurse you like a child at the breast. \q Then you will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, am the one who saves you, \q your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
en.R: Nations and kings will take care of you and give you what you need, as a mother feeds her baby. \q Then you will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, am the one who saves you. \q I am your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

es.L: Y mamarás la leche de las naciones, \q y el pecho de los reyes mamarás; \q y sabrás que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, tu Salvador, \q y tu Redentor, el Poderoso de Jacob.
es.B: Las naciones te alimentarán con su leche, \q y los reyes te criarán como a un niño de pecho. \q Entonces sabrás que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, soy el que te salva, \q tu Redentor, el Poderoso de Jacob.
es.R: Las naciones y los reyes te cuidarán y te darán lo que necesitas, como una madre alimenta a su bebé. \q Entonces sabrás que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, soy el que te salva. \q Yo soy tu Redentor, el Poderoso de Jacob.

fr.L: Et tu suceras le lait des nations, \q et tu suceras la mamelle des rois ; \q et tu sauras que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ton Sauveur, \q et ton Rédempteur, le Puissant de Jacob.
fr.B: Les nations te nourriront de leur lait, \q et les rois t’allaiteront comme un enfant au sein. \q Alors tu sauras que moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je suis celui qui te sauve, \q ton Libérateur, le Puissant de Jacob.
fr.R: Les nations et les rois prendront soin de toi et te donneront ce dont tu as besoin, comme une mère nourrit son bébé. \q Alors tu sauras que moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je suis celui qui te sauve. \q Je suis celui qui te délivre, le Dieu puissant de Jacob.

sw.L: Nawe utanyonya maziwa ya mataifa, \q na matiti ya wafalme utanyonya; \q nawe utajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mwokozi wako, \q na Mkombozi wako, Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo.
sw.B: Mataifa yatakulisha kwa maziwa yao, \q na wafalme watakunyonyesha kama mtoto. \q Ndipo utajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndiye ninayekuokoa, \q Mkombozi wako, Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo.
sw.R: Mataifa na wafalme watakutunza na kukupa unachohitaji, kama mama anavyomlisha mtoto wake. \q Ndipo utajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndiye ninayekuokoa. \q Mimi ni Mkombozi wako, Mungu Mwenye Nguvu wa Yakobo.

decisions.choice: suck the milk of nations: be nourished and provided for by the nations' wealth
decisions.reason: The picture follows 49:23, where kings are Zion's foster fathers and queens her nurses. The nations will supply her needs as a nursing mother feeds a child (66:11-12).

decisions.choice: the closing words repeat 49:26
decisions.reason: "I am the LORD, your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob" ends 49:26 as well. "The Mighty One of Jacob" is an old title of God (Genesis 49:24; Psalm 132:2, 5; compare 1:24).

decisions.choice: take care of you and give you what you need, as a mother feeds her baby
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of nursing (see m1).

decisions.choice: the one who saves you
decisions.reason: As in 49:26, Balanced and Readable say "the one who saves you" for "your Savior".

source.text: תַּ֣חַת הַנְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אָבִ֣יא זָהָ֗ב וְתַ֤חַת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ אָ֣בִיא כֶ֔סֶף וְתַ֤חַת הָֽעֵצִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְתַ֥חַת הָאֲבָנִ֖ים בַּרְזֶ֑ל וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י פְקֻדָּתֵךְ֙ שָׁל֔וֹם וְנֹגְשַׂ֖יִךְ צְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In place of the bronze I will bring gold, and in place of the iron I will bring silver, and in place of the wood bronze, and in place of the stones iron; and I will make your overseers peace and your taskmasters righteousness.

en.L: Instead of bronze I will bring gold, and instead of iron I will bring silver, \q and instead of wood, bronze, and instead of stones, iron; \q and I will make peace your overseer \q and righteousness your taskmaster.
en.B: In place of bronze I will bring you gold; in place of iron, silver; \q bronze where there was wood, and iron where there were stones. \q I will make peace your governor \q and righteousness your ruler.
en.R: I will bring you gold instead of bronze, and silver instead of iron. \q I will bring you bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. \q Peace will rule over you. \q Righteousness will be your leader.

es.L: En lugar de bronce traeré oro, y en lugar de hierro traeré plata, \q y en lugar de madera, bronce, y en lugar de piedras, hierro; \q y pondré la paz como tu supervisor \q y la justicia como tu capataz.
es.B: En lugar de bronce te traeré oro; en lugar de hierro, plata; \q bronce donde había madera, y hierro donde había piedras. \q Pondré a la paz como tu gobernante \q y a la justicia como tu jefe.
es.R: Te traeré oro en lugar de bronce, y plata en lugar de hierro. \q Te traeré bronce en lugar de madera, y hierro en lugar de piedras. \q La paz gobernará sobre ti. \q La justicia será tu guía.

fr.L: Au lieu du bronze je ferai venir l’or, et au lieu du fer je ferai venir l’argent, \q et au lieu du bois, le bronze, et au lieu des pierres, le fer ; \q et j’établirai la paix [comme] ton inspecteur, \q et la justice [comme] ton chef de corvée.
fr.B: À la place du bronze je t’apporterai de l’or ; à la place du fer, de l’argent ; \q du bronze là où il y avait du bois, et du fer là où il y avait des pierres. \q Je ferai de la paix ton gouverneur \q et de la justice ton chef.
fr.R: Je t’apporterai de l’or au lieu du bronze, et de l’argent au lieu du fer. \q Je t’apporterai du bronze au lieu du bois, et du fer au lieu des pierres. \q La paix régnera sur toi. \q La justice te gouvernera.

sw.L: Badala ya shaba nitaleta dhahabu, na badala ya chuma nitaleta fedha, \q na badala ya miti, shaba, na badala ya mawe, chuma; \q nami nitaifanya amani msimamizi wako \q na haki mnyapara wako.
sw.B: Mahali pa shaba nitakuletea dhahabu; mahali pa chuma, fedha; \q shaba mahali palipokuwa na miti, na chuma mahali palipokuwa na mawe. \q Nitaifanya amani kuwa mtawala wako \q na haki kuwa kiongozi wako.
sw.R: Nitakuletea dhahabu badala ya shaba, na fedha badala ya chuma. \q Nitakuletea shaba badala ya miti, na chuma badala ya mawe. \q Amani itakutawala. \q Haki itakuwa kiongozi wako.

decisions.choice: gold instead of bronze: everything replaced by something better, as in the days of Solomon
decisions.reason: Under Solomon silver was as common as stones (1 Kings 10:21, 27). Later his gold shields were carried off and replaced with bronze ones (1 Kings 14:26-27). Here the decline is reversed.

decisions.choice: overseers and taskmasters: those who rule over the people, now replaced by peace and righteousness
alternatives: your officials peace and your rulers righteousness
decisions.reason: The word for taskmasters is used of the Egyptian slave drivers (Exodus 3:7; 5:6) and of oppressors (3:12; 14:2). Instead of harsh rulers, peace and righteousness themselves will govern Zion.

source.text: לֹא־יִשָּׁמַ֨ע ע֤וֹד חָמָס֙ בְּאַרְצֵ֔ךְ שֹׁ֥ד וָשֶׁ֖בֶר בִּגְבוּלָ֑יִךְ וְקָרָ֤את יְשׁוּעָה֙ חוֹמֹתַ֔יִךְ וּשְׁעָרַ֖יִךְ תְּהִלָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will be heard again violence in your land, devastation and destruction in your territories; and you will call salvation your walls and your gates praise.

en.L: Not again will violence be heard in your land, \q ruin and destruction within your borders; \q and you will call Salvation your walls, \q and your gates Praise.
en.B: The sound of violence will never again be heard in your land, \q nor of ruin and wreckage inside your borders. \q You will give your walls the name Salvation \q and your gates the name Praise.
en.R: No one will ever again hear the noise of violence in your land. \q No one will destroy anything inside your borders. \q You will name your walls Salvation. \q You will name your gates Praise.

es.L: Nunca más se oirá violencia en tu tierra, \q desolación ni destrucción dentro de tus fronteras; \q y llamarás a tus muros Salvación, \q y a tus puertas Alabanza.
es.B: Nunca más se oirá el ruido de la violencia en tu tierra, \q ni de ruina y destrozo dentro de tus fronteras. \q A tus muros les pondrás el nombre de Salvación \q y a tus puertas el nombre de Alabanza.
es.R: Nadie volverá a oír el ruido de la violencia en tu tierra. \q Nadie destruirá nada dentro de tus fronteras. \q Llamarás a tus muros Salvación. \q Llamarás a tus puertas Alabanza.

fr.L: On n’entendra plus parler de violence dans ton pays, \q de ravage et de ruine dans tes frontières ; \q et tu appelleras tes murailles Salut, \q et tes portes Louange.
fr.B: On n’entendra plus jamais le bruit de la violence dans ton pays, \q ni celui du ravage et de la ruine à l’intérieur de tes frontières. \q Tu donneras à tes murailles le nom de Salut \q et à tes portes le nom de Louange.
fr.R: Plus personne n’entendra le bruit de la violence dans ton pays. \q Personne ne détruira plus rien dans tes frontières. \q Tu appelleras tes murailles « Salut ». \q Tu appelleras tes portes « Louange ».

sw.L: Jeuri haitasikika tena katika nchi yako, \q uharibifu na uvunjaji ndani ya mipaka yako; \q nawe utaziita kuta zako Wokovu, \q na malango yako Sifa.
sw.B: Sauti ya jeuri haitasikika tena kamwe katika nchi yako, \q wala ya maangamizi na uharibifu ndani ya mipaka yako. \q Utazipa kuta zako jina Wokovu \q na malango yako jina Sifa.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu atakayesikia tena kelele za jeuri katika nchi yako. \q Hakuna atakayeharibu kitu chochote ndani ya mipaka yako. \q Utaziita kuta zako Wokovu. \q Utayaita malango yako Sifa.

decisions.choice: ruin and destruction: a set pair for the devastation of war
decisions.reason: The same pair describes Jerusalem's fall in 51:19 and the deeds of the wicked in 59:7.

decisions.choice: walls called Salvation, gates called Praise: the city's safety is God's saving power, and its gates are places of praise
decisions.reason: In 26:1 God sets salvation as the city's walls and ramparts. The city will be protected by what God does, not by its stones.

source.text: לֹא־יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֨ךְ ע֤וֹד הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לְא֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם וּלְנֹ֕גַהּ הַיָּרֵ֖חַ לֹא־יָאִ֣יר לָ֑ךְ וְהָיָה־לָ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ לְא֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וֵאלֹהַ֖יִךְ לְתִפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will be to you again the sun for light by day, and for brightness the moon will not shine for you; and will be to you Yahweh for a light of perpetuity, and your God for your beauty.

en.L: The sun will no longer be to you for light by day, \q and for brightness the moon will not shine for you; \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be to you an everlasting light, \q and your God your splendor.
en.B: No longer will the sun be what lights your day, \q nor the glow of the moon what shines on you; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be your light for all time, \q and your God will be your splendor.
en.R: You will not need the sun to give you light during the day. \q You will not need the moon to shine for you. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will be your light forever. \q Your God will be your glory.

es.L: Ya no será el sol tu luz de día, \q ni para resplandor te alumbrará la luna; \q sino que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será para ti luz eterna, \q y tu Dios tu hermosura.
es.B: Ya no será el sol lo que alumbre tu día, \q ni el brillo de la luna lo que te ilumine; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será tu luz para siempre, \q y tu Dios será tu esplendor.
es.R: No necesitarás el sol para que te dé luz durante el día. \q No necesitarás que la luna brille para ti. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será tu luz para siempre. \q Tu Dios será tu gloria.

fr.L: Le soleil ne sera plus pour toi la lumière du jour, \q et pour l’éclat, la lune ne brillera plus pour toi ; \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera pour toi une lumière éternelle, \q et ton Dieu ta splendeur.
fr.B: Ce ne sera plus le soleil qui éclairera tes jours, \q ni la lueur de la lune qui brillera sur toi ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera ta lumière pour toujours, \q et ton Dieu sera ta splendeur.
fr.R: Tu n’auras plus besoin du soleil pour t’éclairer pendant la journée. \q Tu n’auras plus besoin de la lune pour briller sur toi. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera ta lumière pour toujours. \q Ton Dieu sera ta gloire.

sw.L: Jua halitakuwa tena nuru yako mchana, \q wala mwezi hautakuangazia kwa mwangaza; \q bali {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa nuru yako ya milele, \q na Mungu wako fahari yako.
sw.B: Jua halitakuwa tena ndilo linaloangaza mchana wako, \q wala mwanga wa mwezi hautakuwa ndio unaokuangazia; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa nuru yako nyakati zote, \q na Mungu wako atakuwa fahari yako.
sw.R: Hutahitaji jua kukupa mwanga wakati wa mchana. \q Hutahitaji mwezi ukuangazie. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa nuru yako milele. \q Mungu wako atakuwa utukufu wako.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew text has no "by night" in the second line
alternatives: nor will the moon shine for you by night
decisions.reason: The Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) and the Septuagint appear to read "by night" with the moon, balancing "by day" (reported from memory; to be checked). The meaning is the same either way: neither sun nor moon will be needed.

decisions.choice: the LORD your everlasting light: God's own presence replacing sun and moon
decisions.reason: Revelation 21:23 and 22:5 take up this verse: the city has no need of sun or moon, because the glory of God gives it light and the Lamb is its lamp.

decisions.choice: your glory
decisions.reason: The word means beauty or splendor; Readable says "glory", a more familiar word for the same idea.

source.text: לֹא־יָב֥וֹא עוֹד֙ שִׁמְשֵׁ֔ךְ וִירֵחֵ֖ךְ לֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה־לָּךְ֙ לְא֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וְשָׁלְמ֖וּ יְמֵ֥י אֶבְלֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will go down again your sun, and your moon will not be withdrawn; for Yahweh will be to you for a light of perpetuity, and will be completed the days of your mourning.

en.L: Your sun will not again go down, \q and your moon will not be taken away; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be for you an everlasting light, \q and the days of your mourning will be completed.
en.B: Your sun will set no more, \q and your moon will never fade; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be your light for all time, \q and your days of grief will be over.
en.R: Your sun will never go down again. \q Your moon will never disappear. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will be your light forever. \q Your days of sadness will come to an end.

es.L: Nunca más se pondrá tu sol, \q ni tu luna menguará; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será para ti luz eterna, \q y se cumplirán los días de tu luto.
es.B: Tu sol no se pondrá nunca más, \q y tu luna nunca se apagará; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será tu luz para siempre, \q y tus días de dolor habrán terminado.
es.R: Tu sol nunca más se pondrá. \q Tu luna nunca desaparecerá. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} será tu luz para siempre. \q Tus días de tristeza llegarán a su fin.

fr.L: Ton soleil ne se couchera plus, \q et ta lune ne se retirera pas ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera pour toi une lumière éternelle, \q et les jours de ton deuil seront achevés.
fr.B: Ton soleil ne se couchera plus, \q et ta lune ne déclinera jamais ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera ta lumière pour toujours, \q et tes jours de deuil seront finis.
fr.R: Ton soleil ne se couchera plus jamais. \q Ta lune ne disparaîtra plus jamais. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera ta lumière pour toujours. \q Tes jours de tristesse prendront fin.

sw.L: Jua lako halitazama tena, \q wala mwezi wako hautaondolewa; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa kwako nuru ya milele, \q na siku za maombolezo yako zitatimia.
sw.B: Jua lako halitatua tena, \q wala mwezi wako hautafifia kamwe; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa nuru yako nyakati zote, \q na siku zako za huzuni zitakwisha.
sw.R: Jua lako halitazama tena kamwe. \q Mwezi wako hautatoweka kamwe. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa nuru yako milele. \q Siku zako za huzuni zitafikia mwisho.

decisions.choice: be taken away: the moon withdrawing its light
decisions.reason: The verb means to be gathered in or withdrawn. It is used of stars that withdraw their brightness in Joel 2:10; 4:15.

decisions.choice: the days of mourning completed: grief has a fixed end, set by God
decisions.reason: Mourning for Zion ends because God himself becomes her light (61:2-3; 65:19; Revelation 21:4).

source.text: וְעַמֵּךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים לְעוֹלָ֖ם יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ נֵ֧צֶר מַטָּעַ֛י מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֖י לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And your people, all of them [will be] righteous; forever they will possess [the] land, [the] shoot of my planting, [the] work of my hands, to glorify myself.

en.L: And your people, all of them [will be] righteous; \q forever they will possess [the] land, \q the shoot of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} planting, the work of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands, to show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beauty.
en.B: Every one of your people will be righteous, \q and the land will be theirs for all time. \q They are a young branch {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own hand has set in the ground, the work of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands, to show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beauty.
en.R: All your people will be righteous. \q The land will belong to them forever. \q I planted them like a young tree. I made them with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own hands to show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} beauty.

es.L: Y tu pueblo, todos ellos [serán] justos; \q para siempre poseerán [la] tierra, \q el renuevo de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} plantío, la obra de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos, para mostrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hermosura.
es.B: Todo tu pueblo será justo, \q y la tierra será suya para siempre. \q Son un brote nuevo que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia mano ha plantado, la obra de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos, para mostrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hermosura.
es.R: Todo tu pueblo será justo. \q La tierra les pertenecerá para siempre. \q Los planté como a un árbol joven. Los hice con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} propias manos para mostrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hermosura.

fr.L: Et ton peuple, eux tous [seront] justes ; \q pour toujours ils posséderont le pays, \q le rejeton de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} plantation, l’œuvre de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains, pour manifester {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur.
fr.B: Tous les gens de ton peuple seront justes, \q et le pays sera à eux pour toujours. \q Ils sont une jeune pousse que {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} propre main a mise en terre, l’œuvre de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains, pour manifester {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur.
fr.R: Tout ton peuple sera juste. \q Le pays leur appartiendra pour toujours. \q Je les ai plantés comme un jeune arbre. Je les ai faits de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} propres mains pour montrer {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} splendeur.

sw.L: Na watu wako, wote [watakuwa] wenye haki; \q milele wataimiliki nchi, \q chipukizi la upandaji {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ili kuonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Kila mmoja wa watu wako atakuwa mwenye haki, \q na nchi itakuwa yao nyakati zote. \q Wao ni chipukizi changa ambalo mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe umelipanda ardhini, kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ili kuonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Watu wako wote watakuwa wenye haki. \q Nchi itakuwa yao milele. \q Niliwapanda kama mti mchanga. Niliwafanya kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mwenyewe ili kuonyesha uzuri {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

decisions.choice: my planting: the qere; the ketiv reads "his planting"
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Leningrad Codex (the ketiv) can be read "his planting" or "its planting"; the Masoretes' reading (the qere) is "my planting", which fits "my hands" in the next phrase. The Great Isaiah Scroll (1QIsa-a) is reported to read "the planting of the LORD", as in 61:3 (from memory; to be checked).

decisions.choice: possess the land; the shoot: the people as the new growth God has planted
decisions.reason: Possessing the land forever recalls the promise to Abraham (Genesis 15:7; 17:8; Psalm 37:11, 29; Matthew 5:5). "Shoot" is the word used of the shoot from Jesse's roots in 11:1; here it is the whole people. The picture of God's planting returns in 61:3.

decisions.choice: to show my beauty: so that God's splendor may be seen in them
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the same root as "beauty" in verses 7, 9, 13 and 19; it means to display beauty or be glorified. The same phrase ends 61:3.

source.text: הַקָּטֹן֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָאֶ֔לֶף וְהַצָּעִ֖יר לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּעִתָּ֥הּ אֲחִישֶֽׁנָּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: The small will become a thousand, and the little a mighty nation; I [am] Yahweh; in its time I will hasten it.

en.L: The least will become a thousand, \q and the smallest a mighty nation; \q I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; in its time I will hasten it.
en.B: The smallest family among you will grow to a thousand, \q the weakest into a strong nation. \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; when the time is right, I will bring it about quickly.
en.R: Even the smallest family will grow to a thousand people. \q The weakest group will become a powerful nation. \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. When the right time comes, I will make this happen quickly.

es.L: El más pequeño llegará a ser mil, \q y el menor, una nación poderosa; \q yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; a su tiempo lo apresuraré.
es.B: La familia más pequeña entre los tuyos crecerá hasta ser mil, \q la más débil, hasta ser una nación fuerte. \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; cuando llegue el momento, lo haré realidad rápidamente.
es.R: Hasta la familia más pequeña crecerá hasta tener mil personas. \q El grupo más débil se convertirá en una nación poderosa. \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Cuando llegue el tiempo, haré que esto suceda rápidamente.

fr.L: Le plus petit deviendra un millier, \q et le moindre une nation puissante ; \q je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; en son temps je le hâterai.
fr.B: La plus petite famille parmi vous deviendra un millier, \q la plus faible une nation forte. \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; le moment venu, je ferai vite arriver cela.
fr.R: Même la plus petite famille deviendra un millier de personnes. \q Le groupe le plus faible deviendra une nation puissante. \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Quand le bon moment sera venu, je ferai vite arriver cela.

sw.L: Mdogo atakuwa elfu, \q na aliye mdogo kabisa taifa lenye nguvu; \q {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; kwa wakati wake nitaliharakisha.
sw.B: Jamaa iliyo ndogo kuliko zote kati yenu itakuwa elfu, \q iliyo dhaifu kuliko zote itakuwa taifa lenye nguvu. \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; wakati ukifika, nitalitimiza upesi.
sw.R: Hata jamaa iliyo ndogo kuliko zote itaongezeka kuwa watu elfu. \q Kikundi kilicho dhaifu kuliko vyote kitakuwa taifa lenye nguvu. \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wakati unaofaa ukifika, nitafanya jambo hili litokee upesi.

decisions.choice: a thousand: a great number, or a clan
decisions.reason: The word means a thousand, and it is also used of a clan, a large family group (Judges 6:15; Micah 5:1). Either way the least will become many, as God promised Abraham (Genesis 12:2; 15:5; 51:2).

decisions.choice: in its time I will hasten it: the promise will come at the time God has set, and then without delay
decisions.reason: God sets the time, and when it comes he acts quickly (compare Habakkuk 2:3).

decisions.choice: family; group
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "family" and "group" for the bare "the small" and "the little", which mean the smallest part of the people.
